sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 383)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across British BBC radio drama and American modern audio drama syndication, five legendary BBC *Saturday Night Theatre* literary adaptations including Georgette Heyer's Regency romance *Sylvester* (1959), E.M. Forster's *Where Angels Fear to Tread* (1964), Noël Coward's *The Marquise* (1970), Alan Bennett's Cold War drama *An Englishman Abroad* (1981), Dorothy L. Sayers' Lord Peter Wimsey mystery *The Nine Tailors* starring Ian Carmichael (1987), and Jim French's *Imagination Theater* (1959–1999):
